answer_1.quote: We propose a novel framework for metaphor generation informed by conceptual metaphor theory... Given a literal input sentence that evokes a target domain we generate metaphoric sentences that evoke desired corresponding source domain(s).

answer_2.quote: Word overlap metrics (eg. BLEU, ROUGE) are inherently weak for this task... we employ semantic distance metrics. We generate sentence embeddings using SBERT for each of our components... we also include the percentage of times the model produced the exact gold output.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three domain experts in metaphoricity. They were instructed to rate each instance on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 4 (very) for metaphoricity and for whether it evokes the source domain.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated sentence on a 1‑4 scale for metaphoricity and for source‑domain evocation (0 if unintelligible).
